What Each Option Actually Offers

You may be tempted to use Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, or PayPal, but these platforms have strict rules and often exclude certain countries. Gumroad, for instance, has a complex pricing plan with transaction fees ranging from 3.5% to 8%. Lemon Squeezy offers a more flexible pricing plan, but its services are only available in a select few countries. PayPal has even more stringent rules and is not available in many countries, including Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan. Meanwhile, NOWPayments offers a simple 0.5% transaction fee and supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, making it an attractive option for creators looking to reach a global audience.

The harsh reality is that most digital commerce platforms are designed to exclude certain countries. Gumroad, for example, has a list of restricted countries, including Cameroon and Tanzania. Lemon Squeezy has a more limited list of supported countries, while PayPal is notoriously restrictive. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to be country-agnostic, allowing creators to sell their digital products without worrying about platform restrictions. With NOWPayments and a sovereign commerce stack, you can reach customers in any country without relying on a platform that may exclude you.

When it comes to payment speed, fees, and real costs, Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy fall short. PayPal's fees are even more complex, with variable rates depending on the country and transaction type. NOWPayments, on the other hand, offers a fixed 0.5% transaction fee, making it a more cost-effective option for creators. Plus, with a sovereign commerce stack, you can avoid platform fees altogether and keep more of your hard-earned money.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you complete control over your digital commerce business, eliminating platform restrictions and fees.

You can automate tasks, customize your workflow, and deliver products to your customers without relying on a third-party platform. This level of control and flexibility is unparalleled in the digital commerce space, making sovereign commerce infrastructure the clear winner for creators who value autonomy and scalability.
